test_title: PYST 39: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 21 Feb, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

She ________ a decision to move to a new city after careful consideration.
solution:
The correct answer is '**made**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The verb "**made**" is the simple past tense form of the verb "**make**."
 
• The sentence describes an action that occurred in the past ("**She made a decision**"), so the past tense "**made**"
